people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.asv: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the tent of meeting.
